coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping in own bedroom, fan on for airflow
Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet
Making and eating a relaxed weekend breakfast using the kettle and toaster
Vacuuming the living room and doing light tidying as weekend chores
Grocery shopping and running errands at local shops on foot
Unpacking and organising groceries into the refrigerator and cupboards
Preparing and eating a simple lunch at home
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV or playing a game on the console
Attending a neighbourhood community event and taking a brisk walk in the park
Showering and changing into comfortable clothes after being outdoors
Using the computer at the desk lamp to plan next week's community programs and check emails
Cooking dinner on the induction cooker with the range hood running
Watching a film or series on TV and browsing on the phone
Clearing dishes, loading and running the dishwasher after the peak window to prepare for the new time-of-use tariff
Winding down with the desk lamp on, reading and scrolling on the phone
Night-time wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
